review_scope: Independent complete Chinese–English semantic comparison of every effective body unit, title, deck and table cell. English first-review proposals applied before approved historical overlays; Chinese approved historical overlays applied to the frozen source. Structural checks do not constitute this semantic read.

candidate_decisions.reviewer_reason: 恢复对照其他立场迫使作者说出的因果，不是关于说话的同义反复。
主体位置与目的位置不可直接混词，候选恢复主体位置准确。
不同想法不判为对错不等于仅禁止编辑性更正，候选恢复原纪律。
去掉歧义负词簇的方向正确，但claims of necessity把中文不得不被追问（定理四的普遍追问要求）收窄成仅对必要性宣称的质疑。原句与if04u65要求质疑不得不的措辞不同，须用追加整段更正，不能直接接受本after。

changes.before: A framework that requires claims of necessity to be questioned must itself be the first to face questioning. Each volume therefore states in its body its own domain, the evidential status of its sources, and what it does not claim: which proposition holds only over the passages examined; which is a proposition awaiting verification; which can record only nothing found and cannot issue a certificate; which step is interpretation rather than quotation; and where a primary source could not be obtained, so that the associated judgement has been reduced.
changes.after: A framework that makes questioning mandatory must itself be the first to face questioning. Each volume therefore states in its body its own domain, the evidential status of its sources, and what it does not claim: which proposition holds only over the passages examined; which is a proposition awaiting verification; which can record only nothing found and cannot issue a certificate; which step is interpretation rather than quotation; and where a primary source could not be obtained, so that the associated judgement has been reduced.
changes.reason: 恢复定理四的普遍追问要求。中文是要求不得不被追问，不是只要求必要性宣称被质疑；区分于if04u65的要求不得不必须被质疑。其余材料状态与降级说明不变。

semantic_notes: All 40 units, title/deck and the complete eight-row table independently compared. The conclusion is a reckoning, not a ninth volume or a proof of superiority.

Non-containment of four mechanisms is not disjointness. The two-layer screening questions and proportionality intersection remain separate; no unapproved repair of the source's child example was made.

Transferable principle does not automatically deliver a constitutional firewall. The missing argument, execution knowledge dependency, subject-standing boundary and three distinct standings remain explicit.

All three returned tasks remain unfinished: principle/execution, preservation/acquiescence, and the means hierarchy after withdrawal of the Sunzi attribution. The final self-questioning discipline applies generally, rather than only to necessity claims.
